info.title: Ocean.io API Documentation
info.description:
Welcome to Ocean.io's API.
            The API can be used to access all our API endpoints, such as our enrich API to look up company information, or our discover API to identify companies based on specific search criteria such as semantic similarity, technologies or industries.
            Ocean.io's APIs are a set of HTTPS endpoints that you can use to retrieve and integrate Ocean.io's data into your existing workflows.
            All requests should be made through https and the request and response bodies should be formatted in JSON.

post.description:
When the email verifications are done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the Reveal endpoint.

When the email verifications from the search are done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the Search People endpoint.

When the email verification from the request is done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the `Enrich person` endpoint.

When the phone verifications are done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the Reveal endpoint.

When the phone verifications from the search are done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the Search People endpoint.

When the phone verification from the request is done, the results will be sent to you via a POST request to
the url you passed in the `Enrich person` endpoint.

When the companies enrichment request is completed, the results will be sent to you via a POST request
to the url you provided in the `Enrich companies` endpoint.

When the people enrichment request is completed, the results will be sent to you via a POST request
to the url you provided in the `Enrich people` endpoint.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description:
Filter by **all** countries where the company has presence.
Must be provided as alpha-2 ISO 3166 country codes.
`["es", "pt"]` means Spain (primary/not primary) **OR** Portugal (primary/not primary).
if additional filter `primaryCountries = ["de"]` is used then it means:
(Spain (not primary) **OR** Portugal (not primary)) **AND** Germany (primary)

primaryCountries.title: Primary countries
primaryCountries.description:
Filter only by **primary** countries where the company has presence.
Must be provided as alpha-2 ISO 3166 country codes.
`countries = ["de", "at"]` means Germany (primary) **OR** Austria (primary).
if additional filter `countries = ["es"]` is used then it means:
(Germany (primary) **OR** Austria (primary)) **AND** Spain (not primary)

primaryStates.title: Primary states
primaryStates.description:
Filter only by **primary** states where the company has presence.
Behavior is the same as for primary countries

primaryCities.title: Primary cities
primaryCities.description:

CrmFilterV3.title: CrmFilterV3
CrmFilterV3.description:
Filter to companies whose CRM record matches.

Resolved server-side by the search engine, which calls
`integrations.SearchByCrmFilters` with these options to derive a
domain include-list before running the main companies query, so this
composes naturally with every other filter (lookalike, segmentation,
industry, size, etc.).

allOf.title: All of
allOf.description: The current job description must include all of these

anyOf.title: Any of
anyOf.description: The current job description must include at least one of these

noneOf.title: None of
noneOf.description: The current job description must not include any of these

anyOf.title: Any of department headcount growth filters
anyOf.description: The result should match **any** of the department headcount growth filters.

allOf.title: All values
allOf.description: The result should match **all** of the he department headcount growth filters.

asPercentage.title: As percentage
asPercentage.description:
true -> filter on the percentage value of the headcount growth
false -> filter on the absolute value of the headcount growth

growthRange.title: Headcount growth
growthRange.description:
Filter by headcount growth values. Valid range: -10,000,000 to 10,000,000.
If `as_percentage=false`, values are in integer form (e.g., `5`, `-5`).
If `as_percentage=true`, values are in decimal form (e.g., `0.5` = 50%).

department.description: Functional department for the headcount growth filter. Departments are assigned by job function, not seniority — a VP of Sales appears under 'Sales', a CTO under 'Engineering', a CMO under 'Marketing and Advertising', a CFO under 'Accounting and Finance', a CHRO under 'HR', a CLO/General Counsel under 'Legal'. 'Management' captures CEO, COO, and general-manager roles only. For VP/leadership hiring signals across functions, use anyOf with the relevant functional departments rather than 'Management' alone.

If not specified, the following default fields are returned: `id`, `domain`, `name`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `country`, `state`, `location`, `linkedinUrl`, `seniorities`, `departments`, `photo`, `jobTitle`, `jobTitleEnglish`, `currentJobDescription`, `experiences`, `summary`, `skills`, `headline`, `updatedAt`, `connectionsCount`, `followersCount`, `company.revenue`, `company.peopleCount`, `company.industries`, `company.technologies`, `company.latestFundingRound`.
